title: A Complete Intersection Theorem for Large Permutation Groups
summary: A family of permutations is called $t$-intersecting if any two permutations in the family agree on at least $t$ elements. We prove that there exists $n_0 \in \mathbb{N}$ such that for any $n>n_0$ and any $1 \leq t \leq n$, the maximum size of a $t$-intersecting family in $S_n$ is obtained by one of the families $\mathcal{F}_{n,t,r}=\{σ\in S_n: |\mathrm{Fixed}(σ) \cap \{1,2,\ldots,t+2r\}|\geq t+r\}$, where $\mathrm{Fixed}(σ)$ is the set of fixed points of $σ$. This proves an analogue of the classical Complete Intersection Theorem for large permutation groups, thus providing an essentially complete solution of the Deza-Frankl intersection problem for permutations (1977).
comment: This paper supersedes the draft of the second author arXiv:2405.07843

AI.tldr: 证明大 $n$ 时对称群 $S_n$ 中 $t$-intersecting 置换族的最大尺寸由 Frankl 型族 $\mathcal F_{n,t,r}$ 达到，即置换群版本的 Complete Intersection Theorem，基本解决 Deza–Frankl (1977) 问题。
AI.motivation: Deza–Frankl 1977 年提出置换族的 $t$-intersection 极值问题，是经典 Complete Intersection Theorem 在置换上的类比。
AI.method: 极值集合论/置换族方法，刻画 $t$-intersecting 族的极值结构。
AI.result: 存在 $n_0$ 使对 $n>n_0$、$1\le t\le n$，$S_n$ 中 $t$-intersecting 族最大尺寸由某 $\mathcal F_{n,t,r}=\{\sigma:|\mathrm{Fix}(\sigma)\cap[t+2r]|\ge t+r\}$ 达到。
AI.conclusion: 大置换群的完全 intersection 定理成立，Deza–Frankl 问题基本解决。
AI.future_work: 确定 $n_0$ 的最优值；处理小 $n$ 情形。

title: The continuous oriented chromatic number of directed Schreier graphs of $\mathbb Z^2$-shift actions
summary: Let \(\vec F(2^{\mathbb Z^2})\) be the directed Schreier graph on the free part of the Bernoulli shift \(\mathbb Z^2\curvearrowright 2^{\mathbb Z^2}\), with arcs in the two coordinate directions. We prove that the continuous oriented chromatic number of it is 7, that is, there is a tournament on 7 vertices receiving a continuous graph homomorphism from $\vec F(2^{\mathbb Z^2})$ and there is no continuous graph homomorphism from $\vec F(2^{\mathbb Z^2})$ to any tournament on 6 vertices.

AI.tldr: 证明 $\mathbb Z^2$-shift 自由部分的有向 Schreier 图 $\vec F(2^{\mathbb Z^2})$ 的连续 oriented chromatic number 恰为 7。
AI.motivation: 描述性组合中，Bernoulli shift 的 Schreier 图的连续着色不变量刻画其组合复杂度。
AI.method: 构造到 7 顶点竞赛图的连续图同态，并证明不存在到任何 6 顶点竞赛图的连续同态。
AI.result: $\vec F(2^{\mathbb Z^2})$ 的连续 oriented chromatic number 等于 7。
AI.conclusion: 该有向 Schreier 图的连续定向着色数被精确确定为 7。
AI.future_work: 研究 $\mathbb Z^d$（$d\ge3$）或其他群作用的连续 oriented chromatic number。

title: Peres--Schlag's nonempty-interior problem and a shifted-product variant for product sets
summary: We study finite-field analogues of the Peres--Schlag nonempty-interior problem for product sets. Given \(A\subseteq\mathbb F_p\), we ask when a suitable one-dimensional linear image of \(A^n\) is full; equivalently, when there exist coefficients \(t_1,\ldots,t_n\in\mathbb F_p\) such that \[ t_1A+\cdots+t_nA=\mathbb F_p. \] For \(n\ge3\), we prove that, for every \(η>0\), this holds whenever \[ |A|\gg_{n,η} p^{\frac{3}{2n-1}+η}. \] This improves the exponent predicted by the direct product-set analogue of the Peres--Schlag threshold, namely \(|A|\gg p^{2/n}\). We also prove a two-dimensional near-half-density result. Motivated by sum-product phenomena, we also introduce and study a product-type variant in which linear forms are replaced by shifted product maps. We prove finite-field covering results for shifted products \[ (t_1 + A)(t_2 + A)\cdots(t_n + A) \] at the same density scale as in the linear case. Finally, we prove a Euclidean shifted-product analogue: if \(A\subseteq\mathbb R\) is Borel and \(\dim_H A>2/n\), then some shifted product of \(n\) copies of \(A\) contains a nonempty open interval.

AI.tldr: 研究 Peres–Schlag nonempty-interior 问题的有限域类比，证明 $n\ge3$、$|A|\gg p^{3/(2n-1)+\eta}$ 时存在系数使 $t_1A+\cdots+t_nA=\mathbb F_p$，改进直接乘积类比的指数 $2/n$。
AI.motivation: product set 的 Peres–Schlag nonempty-interior 问题在有限域上的类比联系 sum-product 现象。
AI.method: 加性组合方法；并引入 shifted product 变体，证明有限域覆盖结果与 Euclidean 类比。
AI.result: $n\ge3$ 时 $|A|\gg_{n,\eta}p^{3/(2n-1)+\eta}$ 即可使某线性像满 $\mathbb F_p$（优于 $p^{2/n}$）；shifted product $(t_1+A)\cdots(t_n+A)$ 在同密度下覆盖；$A\subseteq\mathbb R$ Borel 且 $\dim_H A>2/n$ 时某 shifted product 含非空开区间。
AI.conclusion: 改进了 product set nonempty-interior 的密度指数，并建立 shifted product 变体。
AI.future_work: 逼近最优指数；处理更一般的多重线性/乘积映射。

title: Robust Quantum Memory Advantage from Contextuality
summary: Quantum contextuality is widely recognized as an essential non-classical resource underlying quantum technology, yet illuminating the precise mechanisms through which it translates into unconditional computational advantages remains an ongoing challenge. We demonstrate an exponential, noise-resilient memory advantage for quantum finite automata arising from graph-theoretic approaches to contextuality. We define a promise problem on an exclusivity graph $G$ for which any classical deterministic automaton acts as a non-contextual hidden variable model requiring at least $N=χ(G)$ states, where $χ(G)$ is the graph's chromatic number. In contrast, by exploiting a structural phenomenon we term \textit{representational contextuality}, a QFA solves this task using a memory of dimension at most $d=ξ(G)+1$, where $ξ(G)$ is the graph's orthogonal rank. This separation scales exponentially ($d=\mathcal O(n)$ versus $N=2^{Ω(n)}$) for Boolean-orthogonality graphs. Crucially, this memory advantage maintains an $\mathcal{O}(1)$ threshold against both depolarizing and coherent noise.

AI.tldr: 从图论 contextuality 出发，证明量子有限自动机 (QFA) 相对经典自动机有指数级、抗噪声的内存优势。
AI.motivation: 量子 contextuality 如何转化为无条件计算优势尚不清晰。
AI.method: 在 exclusivity graph $G$ 上定义 promise 问题，经典确定性自动机需 $\ge\chi(G)$ 状态，QFA 利用 representational contextuality 用 $\le\xi(G)+1$ 维（$\xi$ 为 orthogonal rank）求解。
AI.result: 对 Boolean-orthogonality 图分离达指数级（$d=\mathcal O(n)$ vs $N=2^{\Omega(n)}$），且该内存优势对 depolarizing 与 coherent noise 保持 $\mathcal O(1)$ 阈值。
AI.conclusion: 图论 contextuality（chromatic number vs orthogonal rank）给出鲁棒的量子内存优势。
AI.future_work: 寻找更多 contextuality 驱动的计算优势；实验实现。

title: For edge-color-critical graphs, non-$r$-partite spectral extremal graphs are edge extremal
summary: A graph is non-$r$-partite if its chromatic number exceeds $r$. For an edge-color-critical graph $F$ with $χ(F)=r+1$, let $\mathrm{ex}_{r+1,ρ}(n,F)$ be the maximum adjacency spectral radius among non-$r$-partite $F$-free graphs of order $n$, and let $\mathrm{EX}_{r+1,ρ}(n,F)$ and $\mathrm{EX}_{r+1}(n,F)$ be the families of such graphs attaining, respectively, this maximum spectral radius and the maximum number of edges $\mathrm{ex}_{r+1}(n,F)$. Fang and Lin conjectured that $\mathrm{EX}_{r+1,ρ}(n,F)\subseteq\mathrm{EX}_{r+1}(n,F)$ for every such $F$ and all large $n$. In this paper, we prove this inclusion under the hypothesis $\mathrm{ex}_{r+1}(n,F)=|E(T_{n,r})|-\lfloor n/r\rfloor+O(1)$, where $T_{n,r}$ is the Turán graph, together with an embeddability condition on $F$. As the main application, for $F=K_{1,1,t_3,\ldots,t_{r+1}}$ with $t_3,\ldots,t_{r+1}\ge 2$ we show \[ \mathrm{ex}_{r+1}(n,F)=|E(T_{n,r})|-\Bigl\lfloor\frac nr\Bigr\rfloor+2(t_{\min}-1), \qquad t_{\min}:=\min\{t_3,\ldots,t_{r+1}\}, \] for all sufficiently large $n$. We further identify the unique spectral extremal graph, so that in particular $\mathrm{EX}_{r+1,ρ}(n,F)\subseteq\mathrm{EX}_{r+1}(n,F)$.

AI.tldr: 对 edge-color-critical 图 $F$，在 Turán 边数近似与可嵌入性假设下证明非 $r$-部谱极值图即为边极值图，验证 Fang–Lin 猜想。
AI.motivation: Fang 与 Lin 猜想 $\mathrm{EX}_{r+1,\rho}(n,F)\subseteq\mathrm{EX}_{r+1}(n,F)$，即非 $r$-部谱极值图落在边极值图族内。
AI.method: 在 $\mathrm{ex}_{r+1}(n,F)=|E(T_{n,r})|-\lfloor n/r\rfloor+O(1)$ 与 $F$ 可嵌入条件下证明包含关系。
AI.result: 对 $F=K_{1,1,t_3,\ldots,t_{r+1}}$（$t_i\ge2$）证明 $\mathrm{ex}_{r+1}(n,F)=|E(T_{n,r})|-\lfloor n/r\rfloor+2(t_{\min}-1)$（大 $n$），并确定唯一谱极值图，故 $\mathrm{EX}_{r+1,\rho}\subseteq\mathrm{EX}_{r+1}$。
AI.conclusion: 非 $r$-部谱极值与边极值在该条件下一致，验证 Fang–Lin 猜想。
AI.future_work: 去掉可嵌入性假设；处理更一般 color-critical $F$。

title: On the number of extension closed additive subcategories for uniformly oriented $A_n$ quivers
summary: We provide a recurrence for computing the terms of the OEIS sequence A393920, introduced in \cite{KS}. We also describe a surprising connection between A393920 and the Fibonacci sequence A000045, obtain non-trivial lower and upper exponential bounds for its growth, and investigate connections with partial orders, Catalan numbers, and convex topologies on finite chains. For the representation-theoretic lattice underlying A393920, we describe its atoms, coatoms, join-irreducible and meet-irreducible elements.

AI.tldr: 给出计算 OEIS 序列 A393920（uniformly oriented $A_n$ quiver 的 extension-closed additive 子范畴数）的递推，并揭示其与 Fibonacci 序列的联系。
AI.motivation: A393920 计数 uniformly oriented $A_n$ quiver 的 extension-closed additive 子范畴，其组合结构此前不清楚。
AI.method: 建立递推；研究底层表示论格的原子、余原子、join/meet-不可约元及与偏序、Catalan 数、convex 拓扑的联系。
AI.result: 给出 A393920 的递推与非平凡指数上下界，揭示与 Fibonacci A000045 的联系并刻画相关格结构。
AI.conclusion: A393920 的增长与格结构被系统刻画，联系了表示论与经典组合序列。
AI.future_work: 求闭式或更紧渐近；推广到其他 quiver 定向。

title: Further Results on the Maximum Number of Stars in Graphs with Forbidden Properties
summary: A graph $G$ is called $k$-edge-hamiltonian if every linear forest (i.e., a disjoint union of paths) with at most $k$ edges is contained in a Hamilton cycle of $G$. In 2018, Füredi, Kostochka and Luo determined the maximum number of $t$-stars in nonhamiltonian graphs, thereby extending an earlier result of Erdős. Recently, Berikkyzy, Hogenson, Kirsch and McDonald extended this line of research by determining the maximum number of $t$-stars in graphs that are not $k$-edge-hamiltonian, as well as in graphs failing to satisfy related properties such as traceability, hamiltonian-connectedness and $k$-hamiltonicity. For sufficiently large $t$, they also characterized the extremal graphs, while for smaller values of $t$, they proposed a conjecture. In this paper, we investigate this conjecture. We show that the conjecture fails at the critical value and further establish a threshold-type result describing the behavior of the extremal graphs when $t$ is close to this critical value.

AI.tldr: 研究 $k$-edge-hamiltonian 等性质失败图中 $t$-star 的最大数量，证明 Berikkyzy–Hogenson–Kirsch–McDonald 的猜想在临界值处失败并给出阈值型极值结果。
AI.motivation: Füredi–Kostochka–Luo 与后续工作确定了非 hamiltonian 及非 $k$-edge-hamiltonian 图中 $t$-star 的最大数，小 $t$ 情形留有猜想。
AI.method: 分析临界值附近极值图结构。
AI.result: 证明该猜想在临界值处失败，并建立描述 $t$ 接近临界值时极值图行为的阈值型结果。
AI.conclusion: 小 $t$ 情形的极值行为比原猜想复杂，呈阈值转变。
AI.future_work: 给出小 $t$ 的正确极值公式；处理其他 hamiltonian 型性质。

title: Obstructions to coarse universality for finitely generated groups
summary: We prove that, for every bounded-degree graph $Λ$ admitting a finitely cobounded coarse quasi-action by a group, there is a finitely generated group which does not coarsely embed into $Λ$. More generally, for every countable family $(Λ_i)$ of such graphs, there is a finitely generated group that does not coarsely embed into any $Λ_i$. This resolves two conjectures of Simon Thomas: neither a universal Cayley graph nor a universal quasi-isometry class of finitely generated groups exists. As another consequence, we show that no locally compact second countable group coarsely contains every finitely generated group. The proof uses an exponential upper bound on the number of finite graphs admitting an $(L,M)$-regular map into $Λ$, together with a superexponential supply of high-girth $3$-regular graphs, yielding a sequence of finite high-girth obstruction graphs. A graphical small-cancellation labeling, using a variation of Osajda's labeling theorem following Esperet and Giocanti, then realizes this sequence isometrically inside the Cayley graph of a finitely generated group.

AI.tldr: 证明对每个允许有限余有界 coarse quasi-action 的有界度图 $\Lambda$，存在不 coarsely 嵌入 $\Lambda$ 的有限生成群，从而解决 Simon Thomas 的两个猜想：不存在 universal Cayley graph 也不存在 universal quasi-isometry 类。
AI.motivation: 是否存在容纳所有有限生成群的 universal Cayley graph / quasi-isometry 类是 geometric group theory 的核心问题。
AI.method: 对可 $(L,M)$-regular map 到 $\Lambda$ 的有限图数用指数上界，配合超指数供给的 high-girth 3-regular 图得障碍图列；再用 Osajda 型 graphical small-cancellation 标注（Esperet–Giocanti 变体）等距实现于某群 Cayley graph。
AI.result: 每个（族）此类 $\Lambda$ 都有有限生成群不 coarsely 嵌入；故无 universal Cayley graph、无 universal quasi-isometry 类，且无 lcsc 群 coarsely 含所有有限生成群。
AI.conclusion: Simon Thomas 的两个 universality 猜想被否证。
AI.future_work: 刻画哪些群类存在 universal object；量化 coarse 嵌入障碍。

title: Fair Allocation under Conflict Constraints via Strong Colorability
summary: In the fair allocation problem under conflict constraints, the goal is to partition the vertices of a graph among agents in a fair manner, such that no two adjacent vertices are assigned to the same agent. We study this problem for agents with common preferences through the lens of three fairness criteria: stochastic-dominance envy-freeness up to one item for preference orders (SD-EF1), envy-freeness up to one item for monotone additive valuations (EF1), and envy-freeness up to one item from each side for general additive valuations (EF[1,1]). To do so, we introduce a hierarchy of variants of the strong chromatic number, a graph quantity introduced independently by Alon and Fellows in the early nineties. Our results reveal a close connection between fair allocation under conflict constraints and the first two levels of this hierarchy, providing a unified route to both existential and algorithmic results. For SD-EF1, we fully characterize the number of agents needed to guarantee a fair allocation of a given graph for every common preference order. For EF1 and EF[1,1], we provide analogous sufficient conditions, extending a result on path graphs due to Equbal, Gurjar, Igarashi, Kumar, Manurangsi, Nath, Saxena, Vaish, and Yoneda. We also show that, unlike in the SD-EF1 setting, the sufficient conditions for EF1 and EF[1,1] are not necessary in general. Our framework yields existential and algorithmic consequences in terms of the maximum degree. We obtain that every graph with maximum degree $Δ$ admits SD-EF1, EF1, and EF[1,1] allocations for common preferences whenever the number of agents is at least $3Δ-1$. We further provide, for any $\varepsilon>0$, deterministic polynomial-time algorithms that find such allocations whenever the number of agents is at least $(3+\varepsilon)Δ$. These guarantees strengthen earlier work by Barman and Viswanathan on equitable colorings.

AI.tldr: 通过 strong chromatic number 的变体层级，研究 conflict 约束下的公平分配（SD-EF1、EF1、EF[1,1]），并给出用最大度表达的存在性与算法结果。
AI.motivation: 在图冲突约束（相邻顶点不能分给同一 agent）下的公平分配需要新的图着色工具。
AI.method: 引入 strong chromatic number 的变体层级，将公平分配与其前两层联系；给出充分条件与算法。
AI.result: 完全刻画 SD-EF1 所需 agent 数；给出 EF1、EF[1,1] 的充分条件（一般非必要）；最大度 $\Delta$ 图在 agent 数 $\ge3\Delta-1$ 时有三种公平分配，且 agent 数 $\ge(3+\varepsilon)\Delta$ 时有确定性多项式算法，强化 Barman–Viswanathan 的 equitable coloring 结果。
AI.conclusion: conflict 约束公平分配与 strong colorability 层级紧密相连，给出统一的存在性与算法路径。
AI.future_work: 收紧 agent 数上界；刻画 EF1/EF[1,1] 的必要条件。

title: An edge-spectral supersaturation of Mubayi's theorem for color-critical graphs
summary: We study the supersaturation problem in its edge-spectral form. Let $λ(G)$ be the adjacency spectral radius of $G$. Nikiforov proved that every $K_{r+1}$-free graph $G$ with $m$ edges satisfies $λ(G)\le \sqrt{(1\!-\!1/r )2m}$. Recently, Li, Liu and Zhang proved the same bound for every $F$-free graph $G$, where $F$ is any color-critical graph with $χ(F)=r+1\ge4$, with equality only for regular complete $r$-partite graphs. It is then natural to ask how many copies of $F$ are forced once $λ(G)$ exceeds this threshold. Fang, Lin and Zhai answered this at the threshold itself, and conjectured that for any fixed $C>0$, the condition $λ(G)\ge \sqrt{(1\!-\!{1}/{r})2m} +C$ forces $Ω\!\left(m^{(f-1)/2}\right)$ copies. In this paper, we answer this question with the best possible constant. Building on the proof framework of Fang, Lin and Zhai, we prove that for every color-critical graph $F$ with $χ(F)=r+1\ge4$, there exists $δ_F>0$ such that if $m$ is sufficiently large, $0<q\leδ_F\sqrt m$, and $G$ is an $m$-edge graph with $λ^2(G)\ge 2\left(1-\tfrac1r\right)m+q$, then \[ N_F(G)\ge\bigl(B_F-o(1)\bigr)\,q\, m^{{(f-2)}/{2}}, \quad \text{where}~~ B_F:=\tfrac{α_F}{4} (\tfrac{2r}{r-1} )^{{f}/{2}}, \] and the constant $B_F$ is best possible. Our result can be viewed as an edge-spectral counterpart of Mubayi's theorem, since it converts the spectral surplus $q$ into a linear number of copies of $F$, and it solves the conjecture of Fang, Lin and Zhai in a stronger form.
comment: 21 pages. Spectral extremal graph theory. Any comments and suggestions are welcome

AI.tldr: 以最优常数解决 Fang–Lin–Zhai 猜想，证明当邻接谱半径超过 Nikiforov 阈值 $q$ 时，color-critical 图 $F$ 被强制出现 $\ge(B_F-o(1))q\,m^{(f-2)/2}$ 个拷贝，是 Mubayi 定理的 edge-spectral 对应。
AI.motivation: Nikiforov 及 Li–Liu–Zhang 给出 color-critical $F$-free 图的谱半径上界，自然问超阈值后被迫出现多少 $F$ 拷贝。
AI.method: 沿 Fang–Lin–Zhai 框架，把谱盈余 $q$ 转化为 $F$ 拷贝数的线性下界。
AI.result: 对 $\chi(F)=r+1\ge4$ 的 color-critical $F$，存在 $\delta_F>0$ 使 $\lambda^2(G)\ge2(1-1/r)m+q$（$0<q\le\delta_F\sqrt m$）时 $N_F(G)\ge(B_F-o(1))q\,m^{(f-2)/2}$，$B_F=\frac{\alpha_F}{4}(\frac{2r}{r-1})^{f/2}$ 为最优常数。
AI.conclusion: 以最优常数把谱盈余转化为 $F$ 拷贝的线性数，给出 Mubayi 定理的 edge-spectral 版本。
AI.future_work: 处理 $\chi(F)=3$ 情形；推广到 signless Laplacian 谱。

title: Thresholds for the Frankl-Wang $3/7$ conjecture on maximum-degree ratios
summary: Let $\mathcal{F}\subset\binom{[n]}{k}$ be an intersecting family, $Δ(\mathcal{F})=\max_{x\in[n]}|\{F\in\mathcal{F}:x\in F\}|$, and $\varrho(\mathcal{F})=Δ(\mathcal{F})/|\mathcal{F}|$. Frankl and Wang conjectured that if $n>100k$ and $|\mathcal{F}|>\binom{n-3}{k-3}$, then $\varrho(\mathcal{F})\ge 3/7$; the constant $3/7$ is sharp because of the Fano-plane construction. In this note we obtain three results. First, we show that no linear threshold $n>Ck$ can be sufficient: using a truncated Fano-plane construction we exhibit, for every constant $C$ and all large $k$, an intersecting family with $n>Ck$, $|\mathcal{F}|>\binom{n-3}{k-3}$, yet $\varrho(\mathcal{F})<3/7$. In particular, the original condition $n>100k$ does not guarantee the conclusion. Second, for $k=3$ we prove that $\varrho(\mathcal{F})\ge 3/7$ holds for every nonempty intersecting $3$-uniform family; the proof is nontrivial and does not rely on any assumption on $n$ or $|\mathcal{F}|$. Third, using the classical pseudo-sunflower bound $|\mathcal{F}|\le t^k$ (for families containing no pseudo-sunflower of size $t+1$), we obtain a completely explicit polynomial threshold for all $k\ge4$: if $n>(k-3)(7k^4+k)+3$ and $|\mathcal{F}|>\binom{n-3}{k-3}$, then $\varrho(\mathcal{F})\ge 3/7$. In particular, the simplified bound $n>7k^5$ is sufficient for every $k\ge4$.

AI.tldr: 研究 Frankl–Wang $3/7$ 最大度比猜想的阈值，证明任何线性阈值 $n>Ck$ 都不足够，$k=3$ 无条件成立，并给出 $k\ge4$ 的显式多项式阈值 $n>7k^5$。
AI.motivation: Frankl–Wang 猜想 $n>100k$、$|\mathcal F|>\binom{n-3}{k-3}$ 时 intersecting 族满足 $\varrho(\mathcal F)\ge3/7$，常数 $3/7$ 因 Fano 平面 sharp。
AI.method: 用 truncated Fano-plane 构造反例；对 $k=3$ 直接证明；用 pseudo-sunflower 界 $|\mathcal F|\le t^k$ 得显式阈值。
AI.result: 存在 $n>Ck$ 的反例（故 $n>100k$ 不足）；$k=3$ 对每个非空 intersecting 3-uniform 族 $\varrho\ge3/7$（无 $n$/大小假设）；$k\ge4$ 时 $n>(k-3)(7k^4+k)+3$（简化为 $n>7k^5$）足够。
AI.conclusion: $3/7$ 猜想需要超线性阈值，$k=3$ 无条件成立，$k\ge4$ 有显式多项式阈值。
AI.future_work: 缩小阈值到最优阶；处理 $|\mathcal F|$ 略低于 $\binom{n-3}{k-3}$ 的情形。
